responsibility: Language-specific tree-code definition fragment for GNU Modula-2 that introduces the SET_TYPE tree code. Its purpose is to extend GCC’s tree node taxonomy with the Modula-2 set type used by the front end and related pretty-printing/gimplification code, distinguishing it from the header companions that only provide access macros.
same_name_distinction: Tree-code definition fragment for this stem: it introduces the Modula-2-specific SET_TYPE into GCC's tree-code list via DEFTREECODE, whereas m2-tree.h does not add codes and instead supplies accessor macros for existing tree node layouts.
